project.name: cm
project.description: Automated agent coordination for software development - orchestrates Claude AI agents to execute multi-phase development tasks autonomously.

global_context.plan_summary: Claude Code Manager (cm) is a Rust CLI tool that automates coordination between Claude agents for software development tasks. The manager mediates all agent communication through a strict IMPLEM → REVIEW → FIX cycle with context isolation. Supports crash recovery, real-time TUI monitoring, and deterministic markdown generation from JSON source of truth.

phases.name: Post-Run Review Agent
